shorts_extract.hook: From 'IKTITAF' flashed 25 times to why you hate your unflipped smartphone photo: how Robert Zajonc (1968) proved Mere Exposure breeds warmth before memory.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Zajonc (1968 JPSP Monograph): 0–25 exposures of nonsense words, calligraphic symbols, and portraits + Moreland & Zajonc (1979) subliminal dissociation.
shorts_extract.twist: Visual cortex fluency + amygdala calm, the Mirror-vs-Photo stunner (Mita 1977), and overexposure boredom limits.
